(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM) The captioned appeal is by the claimants questioning the quantum of compensation determined by the Tribunal in MVC No.250/2017.
2. The respondent-Corporation admits its liability.
Hence, the appeal is purely on quantum.
3. The claimants, who are widow and children of one Anwar Attar filed a claim petition.
The claimants contended that husband of appellant No.1 died in a road NC: 2024:KHC-K:8490 traffic accident dated 12.12.2016.
Hence, filed a claim petition.

4. The Tribunal in absence of income proof, notionally assessed the income of the deceased at Rs.7,000/- and without adding future prospects, awarded a sum of Rs.7,28,000/- under the head of loss of dependency.
In all, awarded a sum of Rs.7,98,000/-.
The claimants are aggrieved by the quantum of compensation determined by the Tribunal.
5. Though the Tribunal was justified in notionally assessing the income, however, this Court is of the view that the income assessed by the Tribunal is marginally on the lower side.
In absence of income proof, having regard to the fact that the accident is of the year 2016, the income of the deceased is notionally assessed at Rs.8,750/-.
Having regard to the fact that the deceased was 49 years

, 25%
future prospect is added towards income of the deceased.
Accordingly, the income is assessed at Rs.10,937/-.
After deducting 1/3rd, the income is taken at NC: 2024:KHC-K:8490 Rs.7,291/- and by applying a multiplier of 13, the compensation under the head of loss of dependency works out to Rs.11,37,396/-.
6. Under conventional heads, a sum of Rs.1,50,000/- is awarded.

Since accident is of the year 2016,
10% escalation in the light of the principles laid by the National Insurance Co. Ltd., Vs. Pranay Sethi1 is awarded on Rs.1,50,000/-.

sentences.text:
In the light of findings recorded supra, this Court passes the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed in part.

ii. The claimants are entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.5,19,396/- with (2017) 16 SCC 680 NC: 2024:KHC-K:8490 interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its realization.
iii. The enhanced amount shall be apportioned in terms of the judgment rendered by the Tribunal.
iv. Vide order dated 03.02.2022, the appellants are not entitled to interest for the delay period of 285 days on the enhanced compensation.
